## Build GUI binding using Gradle

The `llama.android` directory contains a Gradle build script that can be used to build the project.

```sh
# Build the project
./gradlew build

# Run the project
./gradlew run
```

## Build GUI binding using CMake

The `llama.android` directory contains a CMake build script that can be used to build the project.

```sh
# Build the project
cmake -B build -G "Unix Makefiles"
cmake --build build

# Run the project
./build/llama.android
```

## Build GUI binding using Make

The `llama.android` directory contains a Makefile that can be used to build the project.

```sh
# Build the project
make

# Run the project
./llama.android
```

## Build GUI binding using Docker

The `llama.android` directory contains a Dockerfile that can be used to build the project.

```sh
# Build the project
docker build -t llama.android .

# Run the project
docker run -p 8080:8080 llama.android
```
